cues: Its characters follow from its job as a boundary.
The cells are joined by junctions, so the sheet is leak proof.
It has a free surface and a basal surface.
It has no blood vessels at all: food and oxygen diffuse up from the capillaries beneath.
It regrows fast, because it is the layer that wears away.
And it is the only tissue that arises from all three germ layers.
